messages:
maria-partners: Heads up — PO from Lagoon (PO #L-9921) didn't route. procurement portal is rejecting due to vendor name mismatch (buyer shows 'Redwood, Inc' vs our legal name 'Redwood Inference, Inc'). Can we triage?

dan-deals: I saw that in the queue. Portal validation rule looks strict. @sara-legal any quick guidance on whether we can accept an alias or need an amendment?

sara-legal: Short answer: we prefer the PO to match our legal name on contract. If buyer can't reissue immediately, finance can accept an alternative only with a W9 + signed attestation. Longer-term amendment would be ideal.

simon-finance: Finance here — we can take the alias for one-off deals if we get: 1) valid W9 from Lagoon, 2) a confirmation email from their procurement that ties PO L-9921 to our entity, and 3) invoice header matches the PO.

maria-partners: Lagoon procurement says their system auto-populates the vendor name and they can't edit it on their side. They offered to attach W9 and a supplier note. Sharing PO snippet:```
PO: L-9921
Amount: $48,000
Buyer: Lagoon Systems / Procurement
Vendor: Redwood, Inc
Due: Net30
```

marketplace-bot: PO L-9921 status changed -> escalated_to_deals_queue (ETA 2h) :information_source:

laura-ops: If procurement portal refuses the name change, ops can create a temporary vendor alias in the marketplace so the PO can route. Ops needs legal attestation + finance sign-off before alias creation. @sara-legal?

sara-legal: OK to proceed with a timeboxed alias. Conditions: 1) W9 on file, 2) finance approval, 3) alias expires in 30 days and is documented. I'll draft the one-paragraph attestation template and post it here.

dan-deals: I'll stand by to create the vendor alias once docs are in. Simon — can you confirm finance will process invoice once W9 + attestation arrive?

simon-finance: Confirmed. Send the docs to accounting@redwood and cc me. We'll mark PO as acceptable and process payment per Net30 once invoice matches.

alex-lagoon: Thanks everyone — procurement will attach W9 and a short procurement note tying PO L-9921 to the legal entity 'Redwood Inference, Inc'. Expect docs by EOD. They said changing the auto-name requires a new internal ticket which will take a week.

maria-partners: Great — once we have the W9 + procurement note + sara's attestation, I'll ask ops to create the alias and update the deal. Keeping thread here for audit. Thanks all :pray:

laura-ops: Noted. I'll prepare the alias workflow and a checklist for the portal audit. Once alias created I'll post the internal tracking ID.

sara-legal: Attestation draft posted in #docs (link): https://redwood.internal/docs/attestations/vendor-alias-template. Short form will be: 'Buyer confirms PO L-9921 is for Redwood Inference, Inc (EIN xxxxxxx). Buyer attaches W9 and acknowledges supplier alias for processing only.'

maria-partners: Perfect — moving to action. (ping @alex-lagoon for docs).
